sources.title: Ausgrid 2025 DTAPR capacity, forecast and limitation datasets
known_gaps: Substation capacity, firm capacity, transfer capability, recent demand and 2025-29 demand forecasts are reconciled for all 210 published ZS/STS assets.
System Limitations Template, limitation interval data and retirement plans remain separate source tables to ingest and join.
Substation coordinates/geometry remain to be joined from Ausgrid's DTAPR mapping portal before map rendering.
Arithmetic firm-capacity margin is not firm connection headroom and must not be presented as guaranteed spare capacity.

datasets.provenance: Ausgrid 2025 DTAPR Substation Capacity and Demand Forecast workbook; exhaustive ZS/STS technical-spec inventory joined to actual-demand and forecast sheets
datasets.selection_policy: Include every published Tech Spec zone substation and subtransmission substation and join each by asset type/name to the associated actual demand and demand forecast sheets.
datasets.completeness_test: Independent openpyxl technical-spec asset inventory and separate stdlib XML extraction must reconcile exactly, with zero missing/extra/duplicate assets and zero actual-demand or forecast join gaps.
